aaf8c02a74.q: What is Bank 5.0 and how does agentic banking represent a fundamental shift from traditional banking?
aaf8c02a74.a: Bank 5.0 represents the biggest change in banking since the Medici's in the 14th century. Banking moves beyond human limits, with humans no longer being the primary customer of the financial system. Instead of everything being engineered for a human signature on a piece of paper at the end of the chain, the new financial system will be geared towards agentic operation. This requires a fit-for-purpose financial system designed for AI agents conducting business and commerce at machine speed and scale.

f721d69c18.q: What is agentic regulation and why is it necessary for financial system stability with AI agents?
f721d69c18.a: Agentic regulation is a supervisory layer built into the orchestration layer of every bank to supervise agentic behavior from a regulatory perspective. Without that architecture in place, we will see fraud, hacking of banks, and manipulation of the market at a scale never seen before. The first requirement is identity infrastructure for machines so that agents have credentials like passports and driver's licenses, allowing regulators to know that an agent truly represents you and has your authority to operate financially.
